suggestions.pitch: A contender gets two starting RB/WR pieces in Jacobs and Diggs for an unused rookie and a backup TE, the largest gain at about 34 points.
Burden and Ayomanor, who aren't in my lineup, bring back Collins and Egbuka from a 2-7 seller with a high chance of acceptance.
Burden and Ridley for Collins and Vidal is the most likely to be accepted at 0.93 and adds a starting WR.
